Advisory.Description: Concurrent surfacing RPC failures can trigger more than one reconnect for the same dirty session, and cancellation during a post-reconnect retry can leave the replacement session reusable despite an interrupted protocol exchange. The private fix introduces monotonic session generations, one shielded shared reconnect flight per dirty generation, and generation-aware cancellation handling across search, access-count, and scratch RPCs. The duplicate-reconnect subcase was introduced in 0.1.24; cancellation recovery affects the broader listed range.
Advisory.Summary: memtomem-stm: Concurrent LTM recovery can duplicate reconnects or reuse a cancelled transport session
